This is an Application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed by the aforesaid Applicant who is facing trial in Special Case No.299/2021 pending on the file of Special Court,
Dindoshi.

The said case arises from C.R.No.871/2021 registered with Malwani Police Station, Mumbai for offences punishable under sections 354, 363, 366A, 368, 376,
376D of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 4, 5, 6, 8, 9(G) and 12 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012 and sections 67A of Information Technology Act.

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the Applicant and learned APP for the State.
I have perused the records and considered the submissions P.H. Jayani 35 BA1712.2022.doc advanced by the learned counsel for the respective parties.
3. The aforesaid crime was registered pursuant to the FIR lodged by the mother of the victim.
The records prima facie reveals that the victim was 16 years 07 months old.
She was acquainted with one Rahul.
She had developed friendly relationship with the co-accused and had sexual relationship with him.

On 31/05/2021, at about 12:00 a.m., the accused - Harshal called her and she went out of the Sujal Dinkar Vaidya vs State Of Maharashtra on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181210978/

sentences.text: She accompanied Harshal to a place behind hotel Re-treat.
Friends of Harshal were also present at the place and were consuming liquor.
She has stated that said Harshal had sexual intercourse with her without her consent.
She states that since she was receiving constant messages from her father, she switched off her mobile phone.
She has stated that on 01/06/2021, at about 04:00 a.m., Harshal took her for drive in the vicinity of Malwani Church.
She has stated that the co-accused Anil came to the place of the incident and Harshal also requested his friend - Anil to accompany him.
She claims that the co-accused Anil who had come to the spot at the instance of Harshal, asked her to accompany him.
He took her near one construction spot and requested her to stay with him overnight.
She claims that the said accused also sexual intercourse with her.
He P.H. Jayani 35 BA1712.2022.doc gave her money and told her to return home.
She claims that she was scared and went to her friend - Sameer's house.
She claims that said Sameer also sexually abused her.
On 02/06/2021, the Applicant herein came to the house of Sameer.
She told him that she had left her home and the Applicant assured her to make arrangement of her stay.
She claims that the Applicant also had sexual relationship with her against her wish.
Thereafter, she returned her home.
4. The records prima facie reveals that the Applicant herein was involved in inducing the victim in going to his house.
The records reveal that the victim who was almost 17 years of age had left the house on her own and had accompanied Harshal and several others and had sexual relationship with them.
The Applicant himself is a young boy of 19 years of age.
It is stated that he was a student of Prakash Degree College.
The Applicant is in custody since 04/06/2021.
It is stated that charge is not yet framed.
Considering the large pendency, the trial is not likely to commence in immediate future.
Detention of the Applicant in custody will turn him into hardened criminals.
5. Considering all the above facts and circumstances and P.H. Jayani 35 BA1712.2022.doc particularly the age of the Applicant, the Applicant is entitled for bail.
